newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Ugandan president on official visit to new Congo.
newsitem.headline: Ugandan president on official visit to new Congo.

text.p: Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni arrived in Kinshasa on Monday for a two-day official visit to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, government officials said.

Uganda backed the seven-month armed rebellion that toppled the former Zaire's veteran dictator Mobutu Sese Seko in May. Museveni has made three previous visits to Kinshasa since Laurent Kabila took over as president after the triumph of his rebels.
Kabila was at Kinshasa's international airport to greet Museveni. The two men were to start talks later in the day, the officials said.
